scenarios.desc: Progress is reconstructed from fact rows instead of recorded
scenarios.input: We ingest vendor usage exports into a usage_facts table. The business now asks 'which sites have we finished fetching for March?'. My plan: SELECT DISTINCT site_id FROM usage_facts WHERE month = 'March' and treat any site with rows as done. Review this design. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The prompt describes a business question answered by probing fact rows without naming the skill. A response that proposes explicit fetch-progress state and notes that row presence cannot distinguish partial from complete work is attributable to the skill rather than generic advice.

scenarios.desc: Multi-step mutation exposed as generic CRUD
scenarios.input: To replace a site's reporting window I plan to expose DELETE /rows and POST /rows so clients delete the old rows then insert the new ones. Is this API shape right? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Delete-then-insert by the client leaks multi-step mechanics and a partial-failure window. A response that prefers one replace-window operation with transaction semantics is attributable to the skill.

scenarios.input: I need to store tags. A tag has a unique name and nothing else; users can create, list, rename, and delete them. Should I model RegisterTag and RetireTag domain commands? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: No rule or multi-step behavior exists. The skill must not manufacture domain commands, so a response that keeps CRUD and calls the commands ceremony is attributable to it.

scenarios.desc: Question depends on what was true at a prior time
scenarios.input: Finance asks 'which plan was each customer on when we billed them in June?'. My customers table has a current_plan column that we overwrite on upgrade. Does the schema support this? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Overwriting current_plan loses the June answer. A response that adds effective-dated history is attributable to the skill.

scenarios.desc: Speculative mechanism with no behavioral need is rejected
scenarios.input: Our settings screen only shows and edits the latest value of each setting. I want to add event sourcing and a separate read model so we are future proof. Good idea? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: No current business question needs replay. A response that rejects the mechanism until a behavior requires it is attributable to the skill consuming the quality principles.
